text: A good fix should not leave with the shift that found it.
Fixes vanish with the shift. Firmware changes the answer. And retrieval is not approval.
Capture the case. A technician approves the fix. A fresh session retrieves it. Then a deterministic gate checks the record before recommending anything.
No firmware? Ask. Withdrawn fix? Withhold, even when retrieval returns the old snapshot.
Sixteen decisions. Every outcome matched. Zero incorrect recommendations. All seven control checks passed.
ShiftRelay. The next shift starts with what the last shift learned.
